project_description: AXIS Design System - React 컴포넌트 라이브러리 및 디자인 토큰

hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 1; node .claude/hooks/hook-filter.mjs commit; r=$?; [ $r -eq 1 ] && exit 0; [ $r -ne 0 ] && { echo "hook-filter 실패(rc=$r) - 커밋 전 타입 검사를 건너뜀" >&2; exit 1; }; pnpm type-check >&2 || exit 1

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 1; n=$(node .claude/hooks/hook-filter.mjs tsx); r=$?; [ $r -eq 1 ] && exit 0; [ $r -ne 0 ] && { echo "hook-filter 실패(rc=$r) - .tsx 타입 검사를 건너뜀" >&2; exit 1; }; pnpm turbo run type-check --filter="$n" >&2 || exit 1

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 1; node .claude/hooks/hook-filter.mjs registry; r=$?; [ $r -eq 1 ] && exit 0; [ $r -ne 0 ] && { echo "hook-filter 실패(rc=$r) - registry 빌드를 건너뜀" >&2; exit 1; }; pnpm build:registry >&2 || exit 1
